integrity: The equations and proof refer to a specified independent-Brownian-noise model; analytic claims are distinguished from finite numerical checks. No independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The frozen-rate path law holds for every fixed finite rescaled time horizon; the sign tail takes the large-rescaled-lag limit only after the observation-age limit. No joint growing-window limit or moment convergence is claimed.
title: A frozen-rate Ornstein–Uhlenbeck window and algebraic sign memory in Brownian-squared confinement
